newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato sees room for new rate cuts.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato sees room for new rate cuts.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Tuesday the Bank of Spain, which earlier sanctioned a 25 basis point decline in its key rate, had scope for fresh rate cuts if economic policies were maintained.

"If the government reduces pressure on the public deficit, as it is doing, liberalises markets and instills confidence in consumers as well as in investors, then there is scope for rate cuts, as we are having, as we had this morning," Rato told journalists after a meeting with an official Russian delegation.
At its regular repo, the Bank of Spain cut its official money market rate to 5.50 percent from 5.75 percent, its third reduction this year.
